extracted.name: Emerald Ocean Cocktail
extracted.description: An original cocktail inspired by the tropical sea.
instruction_lines: First, taste the lime juice you squeezed. If it's mildly sour and sweet, it's fine. If it's too sour, use it in another cocktail.
Green pipermint liquor,lime juice,gin into the shaker. shake it. into the glass.
Use limes with a bright yellow-green peel. Because it's less sour. Rub the lime well before squeezing it, this will reduce the sourness.
Decoration with glass is used monin green mint syrup and granulated sugar. Making movie is https://youtu.be/0FittDMgm-I
